subject: Community Development Block Grant FY2026 Action Plan
overview: The Committee of the Whole reviewed the proposed Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) action plan for fiscal year 2026, which allocates an estimated $1.384 million toward housing, economic development, and public services. The committee heard from several non-profit applicants and referred the plan to the full council for a scheduled public hearing.

items.title: CDBG Program Overview and Projects
items.summary: Manager Laurel Siegel presented the required federal planning documents and explained that the estimated $1.384 million in funding will support housing rehabilitation loans, vacant storefront grants, and ADA-compliant infrastructure projects.

items.title: Public Service Grantee Presentations
items.summary: Representatives from nine organizations presented proposals for funding for rental assistance, eviction defense, senior social programs, after-school tuition aid, and food insecurity initiatives.

items.title: Funding Reductions and Plan Referral
items.summary: Referred the action plan to the regular session for a public hearing on April 29th. Siegel noted that recommended grant amounts decreased for most organizations because supplemental pandemic-era funding has been depleted and more communities now compete for federal entitlement funds.
